entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Well, we've reached the side deck...[n]Now what?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: If getting this door open is impossible,[n]we'll just have to find another route inside.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It's the room directly above here, right?[n]Hmmm...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I see... I would never have thought[n]to climb up from outside.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I mean, we ARE phantom thieves.[n]We can use places that normal[n]guests don't have access to.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The target's room lies ahead. Let us[n]hope he keeps his window open.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We've found it. This most likely leads[n]into the engine room.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I'm getting a reading from inside,[n]but I can't tell if it's him.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Huh? We ain't gonna be able to get[n]in like this. You wanna try forcin' it[n]open, Joker?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wait, really? Then... do you want to find[n]another way in?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What a horrid odor... I would guess this[n]is an exhaust duct.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: No way I'm staying here for longer[n]than I need to. Let's hurry up and[n]get out of here!
